layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, soft studio lighting, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Hadrosaurid tuberculate scale morphology
features: A macro view of a clay dinosaur's flank showcasing a variety of scale sizes
The base layer consists of tiny, bead-like clay pebbles (basement scales) in a light tan color
Larger, raised hexagonal 'rosette' scales are scattered throughout, rendered in a darker clay with radial grooves
The clay looks slightly moist and rubbery, with visible creases and folds where the skin would move
The lighting highlights the 3D relief of each individual scale, creating deep micro-shadows
layer_3_action.action: A cinematic macro shot of the skin texture. The lighting is angled low (rim lighting) to emphasize the height and texture of the scales. This serves as a 'Scales' morphology icon. No text.
